updates.title: AACCC AIAPGET PG Round 2 Choice Locking & Verification Active
updates.summary: Eligible candidates can lock PG choices for 15% All India Quota, Central Universities (IMS BHU, AIIA, NIA, ITRA), and Deemed Universities. Choice locking window closes at 11:55 PM.

updates.title: Maharashtra State CET Cell AYUSH PG CAP Round 1 Allotment Released
updates.summary: Provisional selection list for MD/MS Ayurveda across Govt, Govt-Aided, and Private Ayurvedic Colleges published. Physical joining with original documents active till Nov 24.

updates.title: UP AYUSH PG 2026 State Merit List for SAC Lucknow, GAC Varanasi & LHS Pilibhit
updates.summary: Combined state merit ranking published for 85% State Quota seats across Uttar Pradesh. Security fee deposit window open for choice-filling eligibility.

updates.title: Karnataka KEA PGET Ayurveda Round 1 Option Entry Window Open
updates.summary: KEA opens online portal for PGET Ayurveda choice filling for Govt Ayurveda Medical College Bengaluru, Mysore, SDM Udupi, and Hassan. Verification slip mandatory.

updates.title: Gujarat ACPUGMEC AYUSH PG Revised Seat Matrix & Round 2 Schedule
updates.summary: Detailed branch-wise seat matrix published for Govt Akhandanand Ahmedabad, Govt Ayurved College Vadodara, and Bhavnagar. PIN purchase active.

updates.title: Rajasthan DSRRAU AYUSH PG 2026 Counselling Registration Notification
updates.summary: Dr. S.R. Rajasthan Ayurved University Jodhpur issues schedule for State Quota counseling across MMM Udaipur and DSRRAU. Document verification dates notified.

updates.title: MP Online Ayush PG 2026 Round 1 Allotment List & Cutoff Marks
updates.summary: Directorate of Ayush MP releases Round 1 opening and closing ranks for Govt Autonomous Colleges at Bhopal, Ujjain, Gwalior, Jabalpur, and Rewa.

updates.title: CEE Kerala AIAPGET PG Ayurveda 2026 Provisional Category List
updates.summary: Commissioner for Entrance Examinations Kerala publishes communal category lists for MD/MS Ayurveda seats in Govt AMC Thiruvananthapuram, Tripunithura, and Kottakkal.

updates.title: WBMCC AYUSH PG 2026 Information Bulletin & Verification Guidelines
updates.summary: West Bengal Medical Counselling Committee releases notification for J.B. Roy State Ayurvedic Medical College and IPGAE&R Shyamadas Kolkata seat distribution.

updates.title: SKAU Kurukshetra AYUSH PG Round 2 Allocation Merit Report Published
updates.summary: Official merit report released for IASR Kurukshetra, MSM Sonipat, and SDAC Chandigarh across UR, BCA, BCB, and EWS categories.
